answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: a new identity needs five neighbors endorsing it, each locking 20 credits in the atlas. Each dawn, one in five is re-checked. A yarrow lot names them: each endorser shows a fresh deal or loses the bond; rented-neighbor rings are struck off. Endorsers back at most two, so 1,000 fakes need 2,500 accomplices and 100,000 locked credits against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay one refundable 100-credit lock, keeping full shares.
